notes.title: Event GamePavilionJp feedback supported!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43279735/6413bb22205ede44c5fc552488ccf5a48a40829f.png[/img]

Event GamePavilionJp feedback supported!

At the indie game event GamePavilionJp on 30/03/2024.
We published our event exhibit Version and received valuable feedback.
Thank you for your feedback!
If you have any suggestions for improving the quality of this update, please let us know.

◆Fixes
-Play
Ammunition (Ammo) is now unlimited.
The performance of live ammunition has also been changed.
	Missile: Performance like a bomb that can be scattered in large quantities.
	Bombs: number of bombs that can be dropped increased with enhancements.

Additional enemy species.

-Graphics.
Player and enemy aircraft graphics changed to a minimalist style.
Enhanced lighting.
Updated UI layout and radar.

Sound
Fixed a bug in the sound volume settings.


These are the updates.
We keep postponing releases for one reason: we don't want to release something that isn't fun.
We are always helped by the feedback of our players.
Thank you very much!

notes.title: Towards more playable games!
notes.content:
: Customisation:
Easier to understand, e.g. by adding icons
Battles:
Boss class now blows up on impact.
Almost instant death after collision is reduced.
Increased recovery of EN items.
Enhanced direction.
Lighter video files.

Fixed freezing during mode transitions.

notes.title: Add NewGame+
notes.content:
For you to play as "the easiest shooter".

NewGame+ has been added!
You have more options when shooting down your own aircraft.
You can start from Stage 1 with your reinforcements and resources inherited.
This update strengthens the coexistence of casual and high difficulty levels.

Addition of Practice Mode!
You can customise your machine and play in stages.
For challenging.

Change of display location for Survival Mode.
Moved to the mode select group in the title for clarity.
This is a distraction mode where you can test your machine and kick the crap out of your enemies with your strongest customisation.

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug that caused retention resources to disappear.
